{{Actor|name=ovl_En_Xc}}

'''ovl_En_Xc''' is the [[actor]] for [[Sheik]].

{{clear}}

== Notes ==

There are 9 different forms of Sheik (0-8).

* 8 = Sheik that teaches Serenade

=== NTSC 1.0 ===
==== Overlay ==
 0xA88 // Function that determines whether type 8 Sheik will remain spawned
 0x5D58 //Jump table for executing each version of Sheik

=== Debug Rom ===

All three of these songs are learned as soon as the cutscene begins. The songs are learned again at some time during the cutscene that we have yet to pinpoint.

<pre>
ROM: 0xEF2874 (2405005A) Minuet of Forest (Meeting Sheik in Sacred Forest Meadow)<br>
ROM: 0xEF2A1C (2405005B) Bolero of Fire (Meeting Sheik in Death Mountain Crater)<br>
ROM: 0xEF2B78 (2405005C) Serenade of Water (Meeting Sheik in the Ice Cavern)

0xEF2B7F (Point of Interest)
0xEF2CF4
0xEF2D78
0xEF2E74
0xEF2EB8
</pre>
